title: UPI, NEFT, RTGS and IMPS — which transfer to use
publisher: Artha Kavach summary of public guidance (RBI / SEBI / IRDAI / Income Tax Dept) — pending manual verification
text: UPI is instant, 24x7, free for most person-to-person and merchant payments, and ideal for everyday small to mid-size payments; it has per-transaction and daily limits set by banks and NPCI. IMPS is also instant and 24x7 using account number and IFSC. NEFT settles in batches and works around the clock; it suits routine transfers where a short delay is fine. RTGS is for large-value transfers (minimum ₹2 lakh) and settles in real time. Always verify the receiver's name shown before you confirm, because transfers are very hard to reverse. Never approve a UPI 'collect request' or enter your PIN to receive money — you never need a PIN to receive. If you are cheated, report on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in immediately and inform your bank.
summary_hinglish: UPI instant, 24x7, zyadatar payments free. IMPS bhi instant hai. NEFT batches mein hota hai, RTGS bade amounts ke liye (minimum ₹2 lakh) real time. Paisa bhejne se pehle receiver ka naam check karo. Paisa receive karne ke liye UPI PIN kabhi mat daalo, collect request approve mat karo.
summary_hi: UPI तुरंत, 24x7, ज़्यादातर भुगतान मुफ़्त। IMPS भी तुरंत। NEFT बैच में होता है, RTGS बड़ी रकम (न्यूनतम ₹2 लाख) के लिए रियल टाइम। भेजने से पहले प्राप्तकर्ता का नाम जांचें। पैसा पाने के लिए UPI PIN कभी न डालें और कलेक्ट रिक्वेस्ट मंज़ूर न करें।
